summary: Independently rebuilt the md5-verified BG oracle and adversarially audited the newest load-bearing round-3 results on the spline remainder R = A6/i - P_pole: student-2's COMPACT same-energy wall-trace brick H_mp|_{wp=wm} = -32 beta^2 [4a^4+6a^3 s+2a^2(s^2+v)+(a s+v)(s^2-2v)] with the FOUR-LEG beta=min selector, and both students' verdict that the pair-wall brick H_mp is ITSELF A SPLINE (P(u)<->P(6-u) exchange). Reimplemented the brick from the written derivation (no student evaluator). Reconstructed H_24 at the wall by two-sided exact BG branch continuations. Results: the four-leg-beta compact brick is CONFIRMED at 7/7 isolated same-energy environments, including 5 plus-leg cases where the four-leg minimum differs from and beats the old minus-only rule; H_mp is CONFIRMED to be a spline. Foundation re-confirmed on the fresh build (R denominator-free, all 8 chambers, 52/52 integer + 293/293 rational exact) and 5-pt calibration exact (4/4). Still NO complete compact A_6: the global R_0 and the coupled Moebius/inclusion-exclusion assembly of the beta-minimum fan remain unknown, so the single-orbit polynomial ansatz is dead and the deliverable does not exist. One methodological self-correction: near-wall reconstructions must certify continuity/cell-adjacency (a coarse cluster near a finer wall gave two false counterexamples until continuity was enforced) -- this independently validates student-2's rejection of nongeneric nearby environments. Two minor findings: s1_004 mis-locates the H_24 branch switch (it is the pair wall q35=0 at u=3, not Q_{3;45}=0 at u=61/12); and student-2's round3_wall_trace_scan.json has a stale mislabeled column (H_wall_compact_formula uses the old minus-only beta while the claimed four-leg value is H_wall_beta_formula).

Four-leg beta matches BG exactly in all; in the 5 plus-leg cases it differs from and beats the minus-only rule (necessary+correct).

gaps_found.text: No complete compact closed-form A_6 exists yet (G1). Round 3 confirmed H_mp is itself a spline (four-leg beta=min selector), so the single-orbit polynomial ansatz R_0 + sum (q_mp)_+ H_mp^poly is dead; the global symmetric R_0 and the coupled Moebius/inclusion-exclusion assembly over the coupled beta-minimum fan remain unknown. No table-free full-numerator evaluator exists, so the deliverable and its required compactness account do not exist.

s1_004 mis-locates the H_24 branch switch on its affine slice: it attributes P(u)->P(6-u) to Q_{3;45}=61-12u (u=61/12), but the switch is actually at the pair wall q35=0 (u=3), where the four-leg beta minimizer flips w3->w5. Verified by u=29/10->P(u), u=31/10->P(6-u), u=4->P(6-u). Does not affect the verified brick; matters for round-4 assembly (coupling is a pair-wall beta-switch, i.e. a sorted/min structure over the four |omega_j|, consistent with student-2's coupled-minimum-fan picture).

student-2's round3_wall_trace_scan.json column H_wall_compact_formula is computed with the OLD minus-only beta (nonzero 'residual' at all 6 plus-leg walls) while the actually-claimed four-leg value is in H_wall_beta_formula (beta_formula_residual=0, 17/17). The report's '0 counterexamples' and the meta compact_formula string refer to the correct four-leg version; the stale column contradicts the meta and could mislead the PI. Cosmetic; four-leg claim is sound.

Methodological: near-wall two-sided reconstructions must certify continuity R_L(t0)=R_R(t0) (cell-adjacency), not merely holdout fits; a finer wall near the target wall can make a cluster lock onto a non-adjacent cell and yield a contaminated jump. Validates student-2's rejection of nongeneric nearby environments.
Carried: BG is exactly singular (SIGFPE) at on-shell wall/pole points; approach every wall by two-sided limits, never evaluate on it.
